w10_T4_003446: A stationery wholesaler packed 69 pens into each of 6 boxes to make one shipment, and sent 2 such shipments to a chain of shops. The chain divided all the pens equally among its 4 branches. The High Street branch sold 144 of its pens in the first week. It then put every remaining pen on sale at 5 dollars each and sold them all, and it also earned 65 dollars from selling notebooks. The branch's till counts in cents, and the manager converts the total to dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many dollars did the High Street branch take in from the pens and notebooks together?
w10_T4_003449: In the morning the foreman at a bolt factory starts up 7 machines, each of which makes 209 bolts in an hour, along with an old hand press that adds 70 bolts in an hour. In the afternoon the whole setup runs for exactly 5 hours, and the factory repeats this same schedule on each of 6 days to fill an order. In the evening of the last day, the foreman adds 77 bolts from the storeroom to the order. Each machine cost 1200 dollars when it was bought. How many bolts are in the order?
w10_T4_003451: In the morning, Bruno's bakery counter held 50 bread rolls. By late morning 32 rolls had been sold. In the afternoon Bruno baked more rolls until the counter held 3 times as many rolls as had been left. During the afternoon rush 32 rolls were sold. In the evening he gave 3 rolls to a neighbour before closing. How many rolls were on the counter when Bruno closed?
w10_T4_003457: In the morning, Lucia's warehouse crew had 224 parcels waiting for dispatch, more than the 200 parcels waiting at Marco's warehouse. By midday 39 of Lucia's parcels had been collected by a courier. In the afternoon the crew weighed the rest: each remaining parcel weighed 3 kilograms, and the crew added 26 kilograms of packing material to the load. In the evening the freight company charged 2 dollars for every kilogram of the load. How many dollars did the freight company charge?
w10_T4_003464: Petra had 125 raffle tickets to sell for her club, more than the 100 tickets her friend Jan had. The club gave her 20 more tickets, and later another 79. She sold 221 tickets. For every ticket she still held, the club gave her 5 tokens as a reward, and she spent 9 tokens on a hot drink. Each of her remaining tokens could be exchanged for 6 cents. How many cents did Petra get for her remaining tokens?
w10_T4_003468: Kai keeps a reading log in minutes for a book that has 320 pages. On Monday he read for 110 minutes. On Tuesday he read for 63 minutes, on Wednesday for 54 minutes, on Thursday for 62 minutes, on Friday for 18 minutes, and on Saturday for just 7 minutes. His teacher asks for the log in hours, and Kai knows that sixty minutes make one hour, but he keeps his own total in minutes. How many minutes did Kai read in total that week?
w10_T4_003469: In the morning, 152 people had registered for the town's street festival, and 6 more registered at the gate. In the afternoon, every registered person turned up as part of a group of 8, so the crowd was 8 times the number of registrations. The parade lasted 45 minutes. Before the evening concert, 1055 people went home. During the concert the crowd tripled as the rest of the town arrived. How many people were at the festival by the end of the concert?
w10_T4_003472: Yara and Sami are growing bacteria for a science fair. Yara's dish has 84 colonies, more than the 70 in Sami's dish. After a dose of antibiotic, 55 of the colonies in Yara's dish die. Over the next half day each surviving colony splits into 8 colonies, and the following day each colony splits again into 9 colonies. Yara then transfers 59 colonies from Sami's dish into her own. How many colonies are in Yara's dish now?
w10_T4_003473: A summer camp had 201 children signed up, but 139 of them were away on a hike when the treats were handed out. Each child present was given 8 sweets. The camp leader then doubled every child's share because it was the last day. She also set aside 72 sweets in a jar for later. The sweets are sold to the camp by the kilogram, though the leader counts them in grams, and a thousand grams make one kilogram. How many sweets did the camp leader hand out and set aside altogether?
w10_T4_003474: Hugo's parking app showed 207 minutes of credit. He bought 52 more minutes. He then used 166 minutes while at the dentist and another 73 minutes while shopping. The app refunded 8 minutes for a cancelled session, and a friend transferred 23 minutes to him. The app displays credit in minutes, although the car park charges by the hour, and sixty minutes make one hour. How many minutes of credit does Hugo have now?
w10_T4_003476: In the morning a farmer picked 213 pumpkins and divided them equally among 3 market stalls. At the Ridge Road stall, each pumpkin was cut into 5 wedges. In the afternoon every wedge at that stall was sold for 4 dollars. In the evening the stallholder added 45 dollars in tips to the takings. She counted the coins in cents and converted them to dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many dollars did the Ridge Road stall take in?
w10_T4_003485: A fruit importer received 38 boxes of oranges, and a dozen volunteers helped unload them. Each box held 8 bags, and each bag contained 4 oranges. The importer also had 71 loose oranges left over from a previous delivery. All of the oranges were then shared equally among 3 schools, one of which was Hill School. How many oranges did Hill School receive?
w10_T4_003487: In the morning, each of the 7 delivery vans at a dairy is loaded with 169 crates of milk, and then 5 extra crates are added to each van; half of the vans are electric. In the afternoon, the depot, which is 12 kilometres from the dairy, receives all these crates, plus 46 crates from a second dairy and 40 crates from a third. In the evening the depot unpacks everything, and each crate holds 6 bottles. How many bottles does the depot unpack?
w10_T4_003491: Mateo keeps his coin collection in a wooden box that holds 132 coins. His grandfather gives him 53 coins from his travels. Mateo buys 26 coins at a collectors' fair and finds 20 more at a flea market. A school friend then gives him 66 coins that she no longer wants. How many coins are in Mateo's box now?
w10_T4_003507: Tess's drive from her home to the coastal office was 162 kilometres each way. Roadworks forced a detour that added 45 kilometres, but a new bridge then cut 114 kilometres off the route. Her car uses about 6 litres of fuel per 100 kilometres. She drives the finished route on each of 7 days, and on each day she covers it 2 times, once out and once back. How many kilometres does Tess drive over the 7 days?
w10_T4_003508: Noor planted 74 tomato seedlings in her greenhouse, which is 5 metres long. A cold night killed 33 of them, and slugs ate 11 more. She gave 26 seedlings to her neighbour. She then bought 15 healthy seedlings from a garden centre and planted them. How many tomato seedlings does Noor have now?
w10_T4_003514: In the morning, the donation jar at the animal shelter's open day held 113 dollars, and the first visitors added 66 dollars. In the afternoon a school group put in 72 dollars, and a raffle added 41 dollars to the jar. In the evening a local vet promised to top up the jar until it held 4 times what it held at that moment, and she did. How many dollars were in the jar at the end of the day?
w10_T4_003515: In the morning, 219 students were on the list for the museum trip, but 29 were absent. Then 26 students from another class were added to the list. In the afternoon each student on the final list paid 8 dollars for the trip. In the evening the teachers added 44 dollars of their own to the trip fund. The school office counts the coins in cents and records the fund in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many dollars are in the trip fund?
w10_T4_003516: Iker works as a deckhand and spends half the year at sea. His pay is 70 dollars for each day at sea, and on this voyage the captain adds 22 dollars to every day's pay. The voyage lasts 7 days. From his total pay, 38 dollars are taken for tax and 5 dollars for the crew fund. When he gets home he pays 356 dollars in rent from what is left. How many dollars does Iker have left?
w10_T4_003519: Wen's newsletter had 199 subscribers, more than the 150 that Li's newsletter had. After a dull issue, 74 people unsubscribed, and 16 addresses bounced and were removed. Each issue of the newsletter is 4 pages long. A post about the newsletter then went viral, and the subscriber list grew to 9 times its size. The next day 9 more people joined. How many subscribers does Wen's newsletter have now?
w10_T4_003523: A market gardener planted 231 lettuces in a field that is 40 metres long. Slugs destroyed 79 of them. She planted 49 replacement lettuces and then a further 31. She checks the field twice a day. At harvest she sold every lettuce for 9 pesos each. How many pesos did she receive?
w10_T4_003524: Camila's craft shop has 163 spools of embroidery thread, more than the 150 spools in Diego's shop. She uses 71 spools for a large commission. Each remaining spool is unwound into 6 hanks, each hank is split into 6 strands, and each strand is cut into 6 lengths for a kit. She adds 18 lengths left over from an earlier kit. The shop is open 5 days a week. How many lengths of thread does Camila have for the kits?
w10_T4_003525: The new stadium has 220 seats in every row, 7 rows in every section, and 8 sections in total, and half of the seats are painted red. For the opening match, 4579 seats went unsold. In addition, 39 standing tickets were sold. The match lasted 90 minutes. How many spectators attended the opening match?
w10_T4_003528: Farah had 102 stamps in her album, which has 30 pages, and that was more than the 90 stamps her cousin Idris had. She gave 73 stamps to Idris, then bought 49 at a fair. Her uncle sent her 70 stamps, and she swapped for 46 more at a club she visits twice a month. Each of her stamps is worth 6 cents, and she also has 10 cents in a coin tucked into the album. How many cents are Farah's stamps and coin worth together?
w10_T4_003537: Emeka's poultry farm has 227 hens, more than the 200 hens on Ngozi's farm. He buys 63 more hens. Each hen lays 7 eggs in a week. Of that week's eggs, 621 are cracked and thrown away. He sells every remaining egg for 9 naira. He also earns 67 naira from selling feathers and 60 naira from selling manure. How many naira does Emeka earn that week?
